_about: Lamprey slicer profiles. Each profile lists only what it changes; 'inherits' names the profile it starts from, and anything not set anywhere uses the default in SourceCode/Profiles/ProfileSchema.quorum. Keys starting with _ are comments.

bambu-p2s._note: Values from Main.BambuRun, except the bed: the P2S is 256 x 256 x 256 (Main used 220, which centred prints at 110, 110 and would tell Bambu Studio the plate is 220 mm).
bambu-p2s._topNote: Top surfaces: Bambu Studio's own top surface speed (200) and acceleration (accelSkin, 2000). Set ironing to true to iron them with Bambu Studio's ironing values below.
bambu-p2s._adhesionNote: Brim about 5 mm wide, touching the model and the support feet. 1.15 first-layer flow over-fills 0.4 mm-spaced lines and raises ridges; 1.05 still squishes well on the textured plate.
bambu-p2s._supportNote: With the defaults (1.0 mm tips, branches thickening at only 5 degrees, leaning up to 40 degrees), branches stayed about 1 mm thick for 5-10 mm and snapped. Thicker tips, branches that thicken faster and lean less, and a wider foot on the bed.
bambu-p2s._minHeightNote: No posts under overhangs lower than 2 mm above the bed (they caused stringing at the base). Needs supportMinHeight in ProfileSchema, SliceJob and TreeSupport.
bambu-p2s._overhangNote: Walls hanging past the layer below slow down like Bambu Studio's: 25-50% of the line unsupported 50 mm/s, 50-75% 30 mm/s, 75% and more 10 mm/s.
bambu-p2s._seamNote: Seams like Bambu Studio's: on the corner nearest the back where there is one (aligned), loops stop 0.06 mm (15% of the nozzle) short, then wipe 2 mm along the wall while retracting.
bambu-p2s._joinNote: Solid fill and sparse infill are chained into zigzags, so each layer has a few long paths instead of a separate start, stop and jump for every line.

bambu-p2s-petg._note: Example of a filament variant. Export a sliced PETG plate from Bambu Studio and point bambuSettingsTemplate at it, or the 3MF keeps the PLA template's other filament settings (Lamprey warns about this).

bambu-a1._note: Bambu Lab A1 (bed slinger, 256 x 256 x 256, like the P2S), 0.4 mm stainless steel nozzle, PLA on the Textured PEI plate. Starts from Bambu Studio's '0.20mm Standard @BBL A1' and 'Generic PLA @BBL A1', then slowed down and given supports and a brim for tall prints on small feet (see the notes below). Travel is capped by the A1 firmware at 500 (Bambu's profile asks for 700). The start G-code is resolved for PLA; see the CHANGE notes in it before printing other filaments. a1_project_settings.json was built from Bambu Studio's own A1 machine, process and filament profiles (Bambu Studio 02.08.02.61 keys); a plate you export from Bambu Studio for the A1 can replace it.
bambu-a1._tempNote: Bambu uses 220; 215 strings less between support posts.
bambu-a1._flowNote: 21 mm3/s suits Bambu PLA Basic. Bambu Studio's Generic PLA profile is much lower; use 12 for third-party PLA.
bambu-a1._speedNote: Slower and gentler than Bambu's defaults, so the A1's moving bed doesn't shake a tall part on small feet loose. Roughly the printer's Silent mode, set in the profile.
bambu-a1._supportNote: With the defaults (1.0 mm tips, branches thickening at only 5 degrees, leaning up to 40 degrees), branches stayed about 1 mm thick for 5-10 mm and snapped. Thicker tips, branches that thicken faster and lean less, and a wider foot on the bed.
bambu-a1._minHeightNote: No posts under overhangs lower than 2 mm above the bed (they caused stringing at the base). Needs supportMinHeight in ProfileSchema, SliceJob and TreeSupport.
bambu-a1._adhesionNote: Brim about 5 mm wide, touching the model and the support feet. 1.15 first-layer flow over-fills 0.4 mm-spaced lines and raises ridges; 1.05 still squishes well on the textured plate.
bambu-a1._joinNote: Solid fill and sparse infill are chained into zigzags, so each layer has a few long paths instead of a separate start, stop and jump for every line.

ender3-v2._topNote: Top surfaces print slower than the rest of the skin. Set ironing to true to iron them.
